scope: AEMO NEMWeb; five NEM regions; four 28-day out-of-time seasonal folds per region; 560 region-days; 50 AUD/MWh-discharged operating-cost proxy

method.training_signal: Training-day perfect-foresight BESS actions provide bounded LightGBM L1 sample weights.
method.selection: Each fold uses only its preceding calibration window to select convex forecast weight 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 or 1.0 with a tail floor; test labels are settlement-only.

promotion_gate.paired_bootstrap_unit: region-season total net operating margin proxy

boundary: Historical spot-market net operating proxy for five separate hypothetical 1 MW/2 MWh batteries. The cycling-cost sensitivity is user-specified. Excludes CAPEX, fixed O&M, network charges, FCAS, real bidding/settlement complexity and investment return. The positive SA1 pilot is not promoted because the predeclared cross-region gate failed.
